title: Lightweight GenAI for Network Traffic Generation: Fidelity, Augmentation, and Classification
abstract: arXiv:2603.25507v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Network Traffic Classification (NTC) increasingly relies on data-driven models, yet its practical deployment is often constrained by limited labeled data, strict privacy requirements, and the cost of collecting representative traffic traces. While Network Traffic Generation (NTG) provides an effective means to mitigate data scarcity, conventional generative methods struggle to model the complex temporal dynamics of modern traffic and often incur high computational costs. In this article, we investigate lightweight Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) architectures for practical NTG. Rather than generating raw packet bytes or relying on large foundation models, we synthesize compact flow-level traffic representations derived from early packet-header information, enabling transformer-based, state-space, and diffusion models with only a few million parameters. translated_title: 轻量级生成式AI用于网络流量生成：保真度、增强与分类
translated_abstract: 网络流量分类（NTC）日益依赖数据驱动模型，但其实际部署常受限于标注数据不足、严格的隐私要求以及采集代表性流量痕迹的成本。虽然网络流量生成（NTG）提供了一种缓解数据稀缺的有效手段，但传统生成方法难以建模现代流量的复杂时间动态，且往往计算成本高昂。本文研究了轻量级生成式人工智能（GenAI）架构在实际NTG中的应用。我们不生成原始数据包字节或依赖大型基础模型，而是合成基于早期数据包头信息衍生的紧凑流级流量表示，使基于Transformer、状态空间和扩散的模型仅需数百万参数即可运行。我们提出了一个模块化的GenAI流水线用于NTG，并沿着保真度、增强与分类等维度对其进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级GenAI流水线，通过合成紧凑的流级流量表示而非原始数据包，以低计算成本实现高保真网络流量生成，并支持数据增强和分类任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight GenAI pipeline that synthesizes compact flow-level traffic representations instead of raw packets, enabling high-fidelity network traffic generation with low computational cost, along with support for augmentation and classification.
